name: Devil's Dice
storyline: The player finds themselves in a bar, the owner telling them they owe a very large tab. With no money, the bar's owner offers them a chance to win enough to pay off their tab, an offer which seems too good to be true...
summary:
Devil's Dice is a game about rolling the dice to pay off your debt. Fail, and you'll have to pay the consequences.

Buy trinkets to tilt the odds in your favour and try not to fall behind on your payments.

The game is currently in Early Access and is playable from start to finish, including an endless mode and over 50 in-game trinkets.
